summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (Concise Bounded Description per W3C CBD submission: triples with the resource as subject, recursively following blank-node objects, with a visited set for cycles; returns a new Graph, source unmodified; strings converted to URIRef). Added testCBD and testCBDBlankNodeCycle to test/test_graph.py (plus BNode, Literal, Namespace imports), and a "Concise Bounded Description" section in docs/utilities.rst. Changes are uncommitted. Tests and doctests were not run, per instructions; correctness was checked by reading only. Not done: reification handling, CHANGELOG entry, and the black requirement from the spec's struck-through note.
